title: Autodesk plans to cut about 1,000 jobs, or ~7% of its workforce, as part of a global restructuring plan seeking to strengthen sales and marketing (Robb M. Stewart/Wall Street Journal)
summary: Robb M. Stewart / Wall Street Journal: Autodesk plans to cut about 1,000 jobs, or ~7% of its workforce, as part of a global restructuring plan seeking to strengthen sales and marketing — The move is the final phase of efforts by the maker of AutoCAD to streamline customer engagement and bolster its sales channels.
